gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the details of a specific usage trigger by its SID so that I can monitor its configuration and status.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON object containing the details of the usage trigger, including its SID, account SID, friendly name, and current status.

gold.user: As an account manager, I need to update the settings of an existing usage trigger to adjust its thresholds and notifications.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated parameters and return a confirmation of the update along with the updated trigger details.

gold.user: As a system administrator, I want to delete a usage trigger that is no longer needed to keep the account organized and efficient.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the usage trigger and return a success message indicating that the trigger has been removed.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to create a new usage trigger to monitor specific usage metrics and receive alerts when thresholds are crossed.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the parameters for the new trigger and return the details of the created trigger, including its SID and configuration.

gold.user: As a data analyst, I need to list all usage triggers for an account to analyze their configurations and performance over time.
gold.ideal: The API should return an array of usage triggers, each containing details like SID, friendly name, and current status.
